weight_rule: On retained support, strong weight1 iff exact rational final LR<=1/16, otherwise weak weight1/16. Excluded pairs remain0. This is one threshold chosen after H1aj, with no sweep or outcome tuning.
old_rule: Exact final LR<=1 strong, else1/16, exactly reproduced from archived H1ai fits and evaluated again on new inputs.
shuffled: Same strict weight multiset; retain H1ai full3240-pair permutation generated before calibration/training observations with frozen seed20417000+s. Restrict to retained support and assign firstK weak weights. Labels and geometry do not determine placement.
numerical_gate: Before fresh-cohort access: independently reconstruct exact Fraction LR and Decimal80 logLR at every retained pair; verify strong threshold1/16, equality and adjacent integer boundary cases, LR1 weak, old-rule reproduction and pre-observation permutation. All source structures retained without filtering.
input_gate: After numerical gate and before inference: hash the frozen official file, validate exactly5000 inputs[405000,410000), independently check complete-board overlap against every calibration/training source; require zero overlap.
source_policy: All32 original H1ai fits and their supports, calibration outcomes, query budgets and search seeds retained. Postfit geometry audit only; no geometry-based assignment or bank selection.
primary_hypothesis: Strict canonical accuracy>=50%, strict-old_rule gain>=20pp, strict-shuffled gain>=20pp, and zero invalid certified stops.
primary_intervals: 5000 paired two-way bootstrap draws over32 banks and the same5000 puzzle indices, seed20422000. Each gain supported iff lower95%>=20pp, falsified iff upper95%<20pp; floor supported iff lower95%>=50%, falsified iff upper95%<50%; otherwise inconclusive. Three marginal95% intervals, no simultaneous coverage.
conjunction: Supported iff both gain endpoints and accuracy floor supported and zero-invalid gate passes. Falsified if any endpoint falsifies or invalid certificate occurs; otherwise inconclusive.
accuracy: Canonical exact match including capped returns. Correct certificates, correct capped returns, compatibility, clue-only infeasibility and noncanonical valid returns reported separately. No independent uniqueness assumption.
support_semantics: All retained weights remain positive. All three arms preserve support and zero set, so compatible certificate capacity cannot improve by weighting. Exact zero plus all true edges positive implies Sudoku validity; positive-energy capped returns require independent checks.
fixed_search: Unit1,temp.4->.31,theta.45,C4,tau0,ebar0,tol.001,anneal524288,check4096,cap262144; same32 search seeds. No mean normalization or tuning.
deduplication: Identical complete weight bytes plus seed, new inputs and all fixed search settings only. No previous-cohort outcome reuse.
preflight: Historical H1ah nonuniform backend gates reused; every new search checks150 general/sparse and132 hidden-target comparisons plus6 exact integer field/energy/focus checks including127 unrefreshed moves.
budget: At most20 new GPU-min, four-GPU search wall envelope including per-search checks. No new standalone GPU preflights. No extension or tuning.
stopping_rule: Exactly32 fixed banks x3 arms,96 requested cells on[405000,410000), full-weight dedup only, no bank filtering or adaptive sample/cap extension.
limitations: Threshold proposed after earlier oracle mechanism results; one fixed follow-up, no sweep.
Fresh puzzle cohort but reused source fits; not a fresh-source-bank replication.
